meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 当这个技能启用后，Claude 会先确定界面类型（网页、终端、分页文档），逐页截取实际画面并与参考图或预期做对比，计算差异；再派两个只读审查代理分别核查设计与细节；最后汇总给出“通过/需修改”的判定和具体问题清单。
howto.when: 当你说要检查网页、终端界面或分页文档的视觉效果，或询问刚做好的界面是否符合设计稿、是否有回归问题时触发。构建或修改界面后，你主动叫它检查时才会运行。

say.text: 帮我检查刚构建的登录页，是否和设计稿一致。
say.note: 会捕获截图并派审查代理对比。

say.text: 这个终端面板的边框有没有错位？检查一下。
say.note: 会渲染 TUI 并检查宽度和错位。

say.text: 把这份 PDF 报告逐页渲染成图，检查排版。
say.note: 分页文档会逐页生成截图做 QA。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude captures screenshot evidence for each web, terminal, or paginated page, compares with the reference, dispatches two read-only reviewers, then gives a good/bad verdict with concrete findings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to check the look of a web page, terminal UI, or paginated document, or ask whether a just-built UI matches the design or has regressions.

say_en.text: Check the login page I just built against the design mockup.
say_en.note: It will capture screenshots and dispatch reviewers.

say_en.text: Are the borders of this terminal panel misaligned? Check it.
say_en.note: Renders the TUI and checks width and alignment.

say_en.text: Render this PDF report page by page and check the layout.
say_en.note: Paginated docs get every page rendered for QA.
